aggressive.description: Maximum available concurrency (delegates scheduling to Turbo).
aggressive.intendedFor: High-core local machines or dedicated CI runners.

balanced.description: Balanced profile tuned to avoid CPU spikes while preserving throughput.
balanced.intendedFor: Default developer profile for modern desktop CPUs.

stable.description: Conservative profile for thermal stability and deterministic behavior.
stable.intendedFor: Lower noise and reproducible local execution.
